thread:
nina_pm: Quick sync on the routing editor update. Goals: make priority order unambiguous, improve validation messaging, ensure keyboard reorder a11y.
leo_ui: Proposal: show a persistent numeric priority badge (1,2,3) at the left + a lightweight hover drag handle. That gives both scanning and affordance.
omar_fe: Numeric badge works. Will make the badge editable inline but validate duplicates. For touch, an always-visible handle.
jia_research: In testing people tried typing priorities. Recommend inline edit + immediate inline error: 'Must be unique integer'. Also change copy to: 'Lower number = evaluated first (1 before 2)'.
leo_ui: Two copy options in Figma: short: 'Priority: lower numbers run first.' long: 'Lower numbers are evaluated before higher numbers. Example: 1 runs before 2. If equal, top-to-bottom order is used.'
omar_fe: For conflicts show inline: 'Conflict with "Apply VAT"    - reorder or edit conditions.' Also add aria-live "Priority for X set to 2" when renumbering.
cia-bot: Preview deploy: https://deploy-previews.redwood.sh/1856-routing-priority-a11y
nina_pm: Thanks. Leo drop Figma link and exact ARIA strings here and I'll schedule a quick review.
